quest.title: A Place Left Open
quest.action: Arrange a seat or any chosen furniture inside the home, then invite Brindle to look.

quest.title: Room for a Different Leaf
quest.action: Plant any unlocked variety, then show Thimble the chosen garden place. Existing plants count.

quest.title: The Low Mark
quest.action: Explore the low flood mark from the dry overlook, then compare its rubbing with Rillik.

quest.title: The Unmatched Patch
quest.action: Choose either patch color and help display the mended spore-silk panel.

quest.title: First Melt, Second Telling
quest.action: Carry a copy of the first-melt notice to the sheltered notice stand, then tell Avren it includes the downstream reply.

quest.title: The Cup That Tips
quest.action: Try the broad base on a stable display ledge and choose its finish with Pumel.

quest.title: A Dry Way Home
quest.action: Carry a dry route card along the covered walk and show the marked resting place.

quest.title: A Basket on the Ground
quest.action: Decorate the grounded balloon basket with a chosen ribbon and sit nearby for its still display.

quest.title: The Parcel With Two Homes
quest.action: Explore both labels at the exchange steps and agree to keep two address tags on the shared parcel.

quest.title: A Quiet Place for the Sea
quest.action: Choose a wind-sheltered listening place and carry the soft felt liner there.

quest.title: The Spare Window
quest.action: Explore the unassigned window niche and choose a welcoming arrangement with Ombel.

quest.title: The Map That Leaves Space
quest.action: Explore the terrace sightline and mark one comfortable stopping place on the map.

quest.title: A Little Less Bright
quest.action: Try Glow or a shaded steady lantern, then let Plink choose the dimmer resting nook.

quest.title: The Long Way Round
quest.action: Explore the existing ground-level route and mark it with a loose leaf for Nuzzle.

main_quests.title: An Open Door
main_quests.discovery: A home can be prepared for someone without deciding who they must be.

main_quests.title: Three Small Lights
main_quests.discovery: The garden is the near end of a valley-wide chain of welcome.

main_quests.title: What the Water Remembers
main_quests.discovery: The old paired flood marks record both an arrival and the reply sent downstream.

main_quests.title: A Reply Across the Mist
main_quests.discovery: An out-of-date notice, not a broken tree, made this year's gathering hard to coordinate.

main_quests.title: Room for Every Arrival
main_quests.discovery: The community chooses a rolling welcome with a ground display and optional calm-weather balloon flight.

main_quests.title: The Lanterns Stay
main_quests.discovery: The home terrace becomes one light among many; nobody has to arrive on time to belong.

world_events.e_marks_read: At the dry plunge-pool overlook, interact with both old flood marks to compare their paired messages; walking access only.
world_events.e_signal_tested: At the silk awning, test a steady signal using either Glow or the hand-operated covered lantern. Neither branch requires timing, flashing, or spending magic in dialogue.
world_events.e_water_plan_shared: At the town notice stand, interact to share the copied upstream notice and downstream reply, with sheltered and calm-weather arrangements both included.
world_events.e_festival_ready: After m_festival is accepted, explicitly choose Begin the gathering at the balloon yard. The proposed interaction offers a sheltered ground display in any weather, or an optional calm-weather flight view.
